Who We Are

Built on Family.
Built to Last.

Hernandez Remodeling is a father-and-son general contracting company serving Denton and the surrounding Dallas–Fort Worth area. Arturo Sr. and Arturo Jr. built this business on a simple belief: every homeowner deserves quality work at a fair price.

We are registered, insured, and show up to every job ready to work. No subcontractors, no runaround — you get the Hernandez family on your project from start to finish.
